summary: Nauticus Robotics filed an 8-K reporting a Sixth Amendment to its Senior Secured Term Loan Agreement, executed September 30, 2026 with lenders and ATW Special Situations Management LLC as collateral agent. The amendment restructures convertible loan terms after a series of conversion-price reductions from $6.00 to as low as $1.76, and follows a Fifth Amendment extending maturity to January 31, 2028. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. The deal is a liability-management exercise involving collateral acknowledgments and lender consent, reducing conversion overhang economics for equity holders. Watch for further dilutive repricing, lender conversions, and liquidity signals ahead of the 2028 maturity.
